title: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

reading.body:
A man used AI image generation to create sexually explicit deepfakes of a college acquaintance by taking photographs from her private social media accounts. He then distributed these images across multiple platforms and accounts while concealing his identity through fake email addresses and SIM cards. The system's failure was one of access and deployment: no technical barrier prevented him from obtaining the images or using the AI tool, and no detection mechanism caught the distribution until the victim herself reported it.

The incident shows impersonation and harassment enabled by an AI tool with no built-in safeguards for misuse. The victim discovered the images only because anonymous accounts contacted her directly to inform her they existed. It is not established whether the platform providers detected the activity themselves or what technical capabilities might have prevented the distribution before the victim's report.

reports.title: Delhi: Man held for circulating obscene AI-generated photos of college acquaintance
Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

summary:
A 22-year-old man named Keshav Bansal was arrested in Delhi for creating and distributing sexually explicit AI-generated images of a college acquaintance. Bansal obtained photographs from the woman's private social media accounts and used artificial intelligence technology to create obscene morphed images. He then circulated this content through multiple fake accounts on Instagram, Discord, and Facebook while using various Gmail addresses to conceal his identity.

The crime came to light when the 22-year-old victim reported to the Cyber Police Station in North Delhi after receiving messages from anonymous accounts informing her that her morphed photographs and videos were being shared across Discord servers. Police conducted a detailed investigation analyzing digital footprints and traced the fake profiles to Bansal. During questioning, he admitted that he knew the woman from college and claimed personal resentment had motivated his actions. Investigators recovered a mobile phone, two SIM cards, and other digital evidence, with investigation ongoing.
title_en: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online
